name: BambuStudio
description: Bambu Studio is an open-source, cutting-edge, feature-rich slicing software for Bambu Lab 3D printers. It contains project-based workflows, systematically optimized slicing algorithms, and an easy-to-use graphical interface, bringing users an incredibly smooth printing experience.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Users home directory in the container, stores Bambu Studio settings, project files and sliced G-code.

ports.name: HTTP
ports.description: Bambu Studio desktop GUI (HTTP). Limited functionality - HTTPS recommended.

ports.name: HTTPS
ports.description: Bambu Studio desktop GUI (HTTPS). Primary web interface with full functionality.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file permissions. Match your host user (run id -u).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file permissions. Match your host group (run id -g).

variables.name: DARK_MODE
variables.description: Enable dark mode UI for Bambu Studio (optional).

variables.name: CUSTOM_USER
variables.description: HTTP Basic auth username (optional, default: abc).

variables.name: PASSWORD
variables.description: HTTP Basic auth password (optional, default: abc). If unset, no auth - do NOT expose to internet without auth.

variables.name: LC_ALL
variables.description: Language locale for the desktop session (optional, e.g. de_DE.UTF-8).
